title: Busy weekend in Germany: Comparade, Amiga Meeting Nord, Flashback Symposium
summary: 6–8 Nov: Comparade demoparty near Munich, Amiga Meeting Nord in Neumünster, and Flashback Symposium #3 in Plauen.

title: Amiga Future issue 183 out 5 November
summary: The Nov/Dec issue of the long-running Amiga magazine ships this week; a preview is already online.

title: THEA1200 full-size replica launches Friday 4 December
summary: Retro Games Ltd's full-size A1200 recreation (working keyboard, HDMI, USB, 25 built-in games, Workbench access) is now set for 4 Dec after slipping from its original June date.

title: Amigent lets an AI agent drive a real Amiga
summary: New tool for remote-controlling an Amiga over Remote Desktop — or handing the controls to an AI agent.

title: Cinnemon Writer 0.99 — development back on track
summary: The word processor resurfaces after a long quiet spell, focusing first on 68k and OS4 builds.

title: vAmiga 5.0 released for macOS
summary: Major version bump for the cycle-accurate Mac-native Amiga emulator.

title: AmiKit X13.2 Workbench distribution
summary: Point release of the pre-configured Workbench distro for classic Amigas and emulators.

title: Puzzle Bobble AGA for the A1200
summary: dlfrsilver's native 68k-assembly port — billed as the first Neo Geo / Taito System B game brought directly to the A1200. Part of his AI-assisted port series.

title: Splatterhouse arrives on AGA via Modern Vintage Gamer
summary: Unofficial rebuild of Namco's horror brawler, following his Gunsmoke AGA and Zippy Race A500 ports.

title: Frontier: First Encounters reaches 68k Amiga, 31 years late
summary: The PC-only sequel to Frontier: Elite II finally runs on an Amiga.

title: Unofficial Worms Armageddon port lands
summary: Fan port brings the classic weapons and multiplayer back to the platform where Worms began.

title: Tachyon: a modern web browser for classic AmigaOS 3.x
summary: FreeMEM is building a browser aiming at HTML5, modern CSS, JavaScript and HTTPS on 68k Amigas — a long-standing gap for classic machines.

title: AmiWest 2026 talk videos posted
summary: AmiWest ran 24–25 Oct in Sacramento; recordings of the talks are being shared on the Amiga.org forum.

title: Retro Games Ltd hints the A1200 won't be its last Amiga device
summary: In a Retro Gamer interview, licensing director Darren Melbourne told readers to watch this space for more Amiga hardware.

title: AI-assisted Amiga development splits the scene
summary: A community poll on AI-assisted ports came back 72% negative, even as AI-assisted AGA conversions keep shipping.

title: Summer 2026 Amiga roundup (video)
summary: A YouTube recap of the season — the source for many of the seed items here.

title: LightWave 3D gets native RTG
summary: The classic Amiga LightWave now runs on RTG graphics cards.

title: Working THEA1200 shown at Gamescom
summary: Retro Games Ltd demoed a working unit: the 25-game line-up (Defender of the Crown, Wings, Turrican, Alien Breed, The Settlers 2, Re-Shoot Proxima 3), Workbench 3.1, USB/VHD support.

title: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection heads to Steam
summary: Team17's classic returns with better scaling, twin-stick controls, co-op, a museum mode and a new Horde Mode.

title: OutRun Amiga Edition: up to 50% faster on real hardware
summary: A 40th-birthday performance update for Reassembler's AGA port.

title: Amiga Corporation and the new Commodore: who owns what
summary: A second agreement, with the revived Commodore, sets a clear framework for the two names — and lets products like THEA1200 say 'Amiga'.

title: AmiGUS mini: 24-bit/192kHz sound card for A600 and A1200
summary: A PCMCIA sound card that brings modern-grade audio to the two machines with the slot.

title: AmiCube 1.1 adds AGA, RTG and real floppy drives
summary: The Minimig-based FPGA Amiga gains AGA, RTG graphics, real floppy support and several CPU options.

title: LightTree FM: a modern file manager
summary: Tabs, drag-and-drop and built-in ADF support in a fresh Amiga file manager.

title: ami2ha: run your smart home from an Amiga
summary: Bridge to Home Assistant — lights, cameras and sensors controlled from Workbench.

title: Pocket Launcher: tiny WHDLoad front end
summary: A lightweight WHDLoad launcher meant to run on almost any Amiga.

title: LumiPass: encrypted password manager
summary: A modern, encrypted password vault for AmigaOS.

title: Aonic: Reassembler is bringing Sonic to the Amiga
summary: The OutRun AGA developer's next project is a Sonic the Hedgehog conversion.

title: GTA 1 is coming to the Amiga (AmiGTA)
summary: A native AmigaOS 68k port of the original Grand Theft Auto. Version 0.7.0 surfaced on 2 Nov.

title: Amiga Tools Jam 2026 and Amiga Game Jam 9 running
summary: Two dev competitions on itch.io — one for tools, one for games.

title: The Amiga truce: Amiga Corporation and Hyperion reach new agreements
summary: New deals between Amiga Corporation and Hyperion settle the road ahead for AmigaOS 3.2, 3.3 and AmigaOS 4.

title: Revision 2026: Desire/TTE take the Amiga demo crown
summary: Second Nature won the Amiga demo compo; Oxygene's 64k-Silhouette took the Amiga intro; Abyss's 40k puzzler Popspin won the cross-platform game compo.
